overview: An Indonesian island of rice terraces, temples, beaches and great-value villas with private pools. Ubud is green and cultural; Nusa Dua and Sanur have calm family beaches.
fit: Very good for both; choose calm-water beaches and a villa or resort with a pool.
season: April to October is the dry season (27–30°C). July–August and Christmas are peak. November–March is the wet season with heavy afternoon rain.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Denpasar (1-stop via Singapore, KL or Bangkok)

gettingAround: Hire a car with driver by the day (~₹4,000/day); traffic is slow.

safety: Monkeys can bite; don't feed them
Strong currents at Kuta and Seminyak; use Sanur/Nusa Dua

visa: Visa on arrival (e-VOA online in advance is quicker), about IDR 500,000 per person for 30 days, plus Bali's tourist levy of IDR 150,000 per person paid online. Fill in the All Indonesia arrival card before landing.
